newsitem.title: USA: ArQule in collaboration with Monsanto.
newsitem.headline: ArQule in collaboration with Monsanto.

text.p: ArQule Inc said Monday it formed a five-year collaboration with Monsanto Co.

Under the agreement, ArQule said it will provide its Mapping Array compound sets and will synthesize Directed Array compound sets for use by Monsanto in the discovery and development of novel crop protection products, herbicides, insecticides and fungicides in the addition to other agricultural applications.
ArQule's Mapping Array products are proprietary libraries of organic molecule compounds used for screening against biological targets in generating leads.
ArQule's Directed Array products are customized libraries of closely related compounds for optimizing leads.
They both provide the ability to rapidly identify leads and obtain real-time data on the structure and activity of the compounds.

ArQule said it will receive $12 million in delivery fees for the arrays. For the successful achievement in field trials, ArQule will receive additional milestone payments. Royalties are also payable to ArQule on the sales of products that result from the collaboration.

"This agreement with Monsanto, a leader in the field of plant biotechnology, marks ArQule's continued expansion beyond our initial target markets of pharmaceuticals, biotechnology and separations, into agriculture," Eric Gordon, president of ArQule, said in a statement.
